daily.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico to sue after being barred from White House
daily.summary: Reporters from the three major news outlets were blocked from the White House over reporting Mr Trump called "fake news".

daily.title: Chris Brown among trio replacing Kyle and Jackie O
daily.summary: Bondi Vet television personality Chris Brown, occasional KIIS fill-in host Amy Gerard and former Nova star Jack Charles will begin broadcasting on November 9.

daily.title: Man banned from Oz Comic-Con after allegedly biting artist
daily.summary: A man has been banned from Oz Comic-Con after allegedly biting one of the artists on Sunday afternoon.

daily.title: Darwin teacher takes registration board to tribunal after her suspension
daily.summary: Darwin teacher Bindi Isis is challenging a preliminary decision by the Northern Territory's Teacher Registration Board to suspend her registration. The board argues its decision was "reasonable", pending an inquiry.

daily.title: 'Emaciated' woman never accessed NDIS funding despite approval, inquest told
daily.summary: A woman with an intellectual disability who was "emaciated" at the time of her death never accessed tens of thousands of dollars' worth of disability support funding despite prior approval, an inquest hears.

daily.title: Last-minute guilty plea over fatal crash which killed baby and two women
daily.summary: Court hears Nathaniel Jackman had smoked cannabis and did not hold a valid driver's licence prior to the fatal rollover near Yalgoo.

daily.title: AFL stars and partners hit the red carpet for Brownlow Medal
daily.summary: See what your favourite footballers and their dates are wearing to the AFL's glitzy best-and-fairest award countdown.

daily.title: NRL set to axe ref Klein after controversial semifinal ending
daily.summary: The NRL admits the Warriors were wrongly denied a crucial late penalty in their 12-10 semi-final loss to Newcastle, and that could cost top referee Ashley Klein a preliminary final.

daily.title: Liberian-flagged bulk carrier runs aground off Port of Gladstone
daily.summary: The Cape Falcon vessel, sailing under a Liberian flag, ran aground six nautical miles east of the Port of Gladstone on Friday.

daily.title: Three men arrested after boy shot in face and neck in Sydney home
daily.summary: Police reassure the community that organised crime was not involved in the shooting of an 11-year-old boy inside a unit in Sydney's north-west.

daily.title: Woman given 'too many drugs, too little care' before death, coroner finds
daily.summary: Northern Territory Coroner Elisabeth Armitage has found a Hermannsburg mother-of-three was given "too many drugs and too little care" before her preventable death at the Alice Springs Hospital in 2023.

daily.title: Live: Daicos in line to win first Brownlow as banned Swan Heeney makes charge
daily.summary: Is tonight the night Nick Daicos finally gets his hands on a Brownlow Medal? Or will a surprise winner make for another thrilling count? Follow the updates live from the AFL's night of nights.

daily.title: Inside the crackdown on a $23 billion black market
daily.summary: Authorities across Australia's east coast are cracking down on the fishing black market, conducting raids, issuing large fines and crushing boats soon after they seize them.

daily.title: How Freo's former number one ticket holder has helped Brisbane's dynasty
daily.summary: Brisbane Lions players have told ABC Sport that a conversation in July with NBA champion Luc Longley has helped the team in its quest for three consecutive AFL premierships.

daily.title: Forced job-cuts loom as Tasmanian government prepares to swing axe
daily.summary: Around 150 Tasmanian public service jobs have been identified to be abolished as part of ongoing government efforts to shrink the state service.

daily.title: Footy fans filthy as airfares soar ahead of grand final
daily.summary: Return airfares to Melbourne have hit $6,000 ahead of Saturday's AFL Grand Final as Fremantle and Brisbane fans scramble for seats.

daily.title: Mike Rann on 'maestro of the possible' 100 years after Don Dunstan's birth
daily.summary: On a day marking 100 years since the legendary premier was born, another former premier in Mike Rann recalls his own entry to politics under Don Dunstan's leadership.

daily.title: Man four times over limit breached AVO in crash that killed ex-partner
daily.summary: A judge is considering the sentence of a man who was four times over the legal blood alcohol limit when he caused a crash at an apple orchard, killing his ex-partner.

daily.title: Another indecent assault charge dropped against Alan Jones, amid trial
daily.summary: Prosecutors told the court on Monday they would no longer press one count of indecent assault in relation to a reporter who alleged Alan Jones touched him indecently in public.

daily.title: Wallabies eye Springboks scalp amid Dockers frenzy in Perth
daily.summary: The Wallabies are in Perth to face the reigning world champions, hoping the excitement surrounding the Fremantle Dockers will boost them on Sunday.

daily.title: Chinese-made cameras banned from government buildings show up in EVs
daily.summary: Just a year after hundreds of Chinese CCTV cameras were removed from federal government buildings over surveillance fears, cameras from the same company were being used in EVs.

daily.title: Qld premier refuses to reveal cost to install Gabba wicket into new stadium
daily.summary: Brisbane's renowned Gabba cricket pitch is set to live on with a plan to preserve and install the wicket into the city's new Olympic stadium, but the premier has refused to reveal how much it will cost.

daily.title: Elderly man dies after vehicle collided with mobility scooter in Canberra's north
daily.summary: A 95-year-old man who was taken to hospital for minor injuries after a road collision in Canberra on September 13 dies in hospital after his condition deteriorates.

daily.title: Australia to join Japan, Italy in deaths outpacing births
daily.summary: Australia is getting much older, and it is getting older faster than previously thought. But the major political parties are currently in a race to cut the greatest source of resilience against that trend: migration.

daily.title: Apple store sued after using disabled bathroom as storage, change room
daily.summary: A Canberra Apple store is ordered to pay damages to a former employee who lived with a disability after the shop was found to have used its accessible bathroom as a storeroom.

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.

developing.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
developing.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.title: Live: RBA more likely to raise rates as US Federal Reserve lifts to 4pc
developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.title: Live: Labor folds to pressure, scraps $5,000 veterans allied health cap
developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
developing.summary: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Minister won't say if migration shake-up has undergone economic modelling
developing.summary: Amanda Rishworth has sidestepped questions about whether the government has undertaken economic modelling of its migration changes. Follow live.
